The '''Sonic Servodriver''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] [[Cocktail/Legends|cocktail]] served during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The drink was comprised of [[Sullustan gin]], [[Old Janx Spirit]], and [[Spicebrew/Legends|spicebrew]]. [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] [[Den Dhur]] ordered one in his [[Time/Legends|time]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]], at the [[Rimsoo Seven cantina]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] during a battle between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] over the planet's supply of [[Bota/Legends|bota]].<ref name="MS2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sonic Servodriver appeared in the [[MedStar Duology]] novel ''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]'', a [[2004]] novel written by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]]. The drink makes its only appearance in this novel,<ref name="MS2" /> in a scene written by Reaves.<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:Perryquote.png|creator=[[Steve Perry]]|date=2012-07-21}}</ref>
